_comment: Phasor calculator for the emtk window: the controls of phasor.view.json (the AutoForm spec the Qt tool rendered), grouped, with spin arrows and two columns for the g/s pairs; the results table is a data_table. Drawn by emtk.view_form.

sections.description: The guided tour and the help page.

buttons.label: Guide

sections.label: Polar grid
sections.description: Draw a polar coordinate grid (concentric circles + angular spokes) for reading phase and modulation.

sections.label: FRET trajectory
sections.description: Draw the quenched-donor FRET trajectory for the donor-only lifetime below.
Choose the reference grid, lifetime ticks, polar grid and FRET trajectory drawn on the plot.

sections.label: Donor τ0
sections.description: Donor-only lifetime for the FRET trajectory (tau_DA = tau_D0 * (1 - E)).
Overlay reference grids and the donor lifetime used for the FRET trajectory.
